development_note: Retrospective development: early 200ms stroke proposal followed by 1s pickup veto. Historical initial replay and source snapshot retained separately. Prospective validation outstanding.
notes: Constants are a development starting point, not fitted commercial probabilities.
Pickup score = 2 if impulse>0.5, plus 1 if gyro mean<10, plus 0.5 if direction<0.75; axis is not a mandatory gate.
A stroke-like candidate requires a qualified quiet prewindow, an early transient and sustained directional rotation. Weak/no-roll strokes may be missed.
Contacts during motion remain ambiguous: collision and a second putter stroke cannot be resolved from the current labels.
Quiescence is not proof of ground contact; held_hint remains separate and sticky.
No GO marker, episode label, planned count or future sample is an input to the C engine.
Current 50Hz schema is enforced; this is not a 400Hz FIFO implementation.

A 200ms proposal is not counted. At 1s pickup evidence takes precedence; otherwise early launch evidence can survive later rebound. Two archived pickup false stroke candidates observed in revision 2 motivated this lifecycle.
